The top edges of the binder pages/spine area appear to melt into each other rather than forming distinct, parallel sheets of paper. The geometry is soft and ill-defined.
The metal rivets/ring mounts on the right side lack sharp definition and look slightly fused with the red cover material, lacking precise mechanical detail.
